strategy.audience: Busy operators who assume speed comes from working faster.
strategy.opening_contract: Reveal a counterintuitive way to finish important work sooner.
strategy.notes: The transfer uses campaign planning and different evidence.

beats.source_text: Working faster is usually the slowest way to finish.
beats.job: Reverse the audience's default assumption about speed.
beats.audience_before: Speed comes from doing tasks faster.
beats.audience_after: Speed may depend on a different decision.
beats.handoff: The viewer needs to know what actually creates speed.

rewrite.objective: Challenge the default belief that campaign speed starts inside the ad platform.
rewrite.line: Your fastest campaign usually starts before you open the ad manager.

beats.source_text: I learned this after missing three deadlines in one month.
beats.job: Ground the reversal in a concrete experience.
beats.audience_before: The opening could be empty contrarianism.
beats.audience_after: The speaker has evidence for the claim.
beats.information_gain: A repeated failure created the insight.
beats.handoff: The viewer is ready for the causal explanation.

rewrite.objective: Use the user's campaign evidence rather than the reference anecdote.
rewrite.line: We found it after two rushed launches produced the same targeting mistake.

beats.source_text: The real bottleneck was deciding the priority after the day had already started.
beats.job: Explain the hidden cause behind slow execution.
beats.audience_before: The viewer knows the old approach failed.
beats.audience_after: The viewer understands why it failed.
beats.handoff: The explanation should become a practical process.

rewrite.line: The delay was not production; it was choosing the audience after the creative was finished.

beats.source_text: So choose one outcome, remove two distractions, and schedule the first move.
beats.job: Compress the mechanism into an actionable three-part method.
beats.audience_before: The viewer understands the cause but lacks a procedure.
beats.audience_after: The viewer has a concrete sequence to try.
beats.information_gain: A three-part method resolves the bottleneck.
beats.handoff: The final beat can state the payoff and next action.

rewrite.objective: Give the user's campaign planning sequence.
rewrite.line: Lock the audience, choose one promise, and collect the proof before anyone builds the ads.

beats.source_text: Try it tomorrow and see how much earlier you finish.
beats.job: Convert the method into one immediate test.
beats.audience_before: The viewer has a process but no commitment.
beats.audience_after: The viewer knows exactly what to test next.
beats.information_gain: The method can be tested on the next workday.
beats.handoff: The video can end after the clear action.

rewrite.line: Use that order on your next brief and measure how many revisions disappear.
